en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a winter scene of old fortification walls with multiple brick arches along a snowy moat or path. Leafless trees stand on top of the walls, and a large arched gateway is visible in the background. On the right margin, there is vertical German text and a small coat of arms, suggesting it is a historical view of a European fortress structure.
